title: Deep researcher
description: Answers a question from the corpus this folio ALREADY HOLDS, and stands behind the answer's citations. `agent` rather than `person`, and the reason is the opposite of `librarian`'s: nothing in this loop decides what may be redistributed or what a source means in law — it plans, retrieves, filters and synthesises over material a person has already admitted. The role admits `person` too, and no person-shaped actor is registered for it because none has been named; inventing one would assert a party this repository does not have. WHAT THIS ACTOR MAY NOT DO is report an agent's draft figure description as what the figure shows — `schemas/narrative.ts` holds that line, and it is why an agent performing this is legitimate in the first place.
